## Change

Describe the use case and resulting behavior.

## Verification

List the replay command and relevant checks run. Identify simulated or untested behavior.

Name the caller-interface tests added or exercised, and link the agreed issue/scope.
For packaging/MCP changes, include clean installation and supported client evidence.

## Data and effects

When relevant, record data provenance and live disclosure, budget and effect authority.

- [ ] Default checks need no provider credentials or expert spend.
- [ ] The diff contains no secrets, raw private runs or uncleared replay content.
